requirements_summary: Workload: ticket summarization paired with tool-calling to carrier APIs
Outputs: strict JSON schema (carrier_status{carrier,tracking,eta,status_code}) to populate Zendesk fields
Latency target: prefer sub-500ms for simple status lookups; up to 2s acceptable when summarizing full ticket
Throughput: low-medium (bursty after promotions). Batch-friendly but want fast single-ticket turnaround
Quality constraints: high factuality for carrier replies; structured fields must be reliable
Security: SSO for team, audit logs for PII access, short retention for ticket text (30–90 days), KMS optional
